previousFindings.round 5 connection.ts:188 gap: Closed by 52159aaf in the order the tests replay. Against ygo the gap never opened: ygo queues SyncStep1/SyncStep2 before its read loop and writes Authenticated only from the read loop (ygo@v1.51.3-sami.4 server.go:2088-2097, peer.go:330-341), so the client syncs before it is authenticated.
previousFindings.earlier rounds: No other earlier finding came back.

keyFindings.description: takeAdmission records the read-only load's held heading-id stamp at writable authentication, after the client's SyncStep2 to ygo's SyncStep1 is already in `sent` with a lower `through`, and no Update frame carries it, so the row stays stored and counted: offline or connecting, the page says '1 edit saved in this browser, not sent yet.' with nothing unsent (deep-review probe in ygo's frame order). If the issue then closes again, the read-only reconnect's SyncStep2 is answered applied=0 (peer.go:245-249, roomHolds false for a refused stamp) and otherClientsRows keeps own rows out of the prune, so the page shows round 1's false notice '1 edit saved in this browser can't be sent: this document is read-only.' [traced from code]. The new tests replay Authenticated before the sync, an order ygo never sends.
